subject: pol-con
title: (R)POL.CON.------SPT.DYM.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-38 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two) accompanying Braxton's framing of culture-information focus: 'the collective forces which dictate how given information lines are interpreted to either the composite spectrum (people) of a given culture, or to the composite whole of its effective parameter (which in this case is planet Earth).' (C)POL-CON (the concept of political consciousness) is crossed with SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics): the question is what political-consciousness produces when crossed with spiritual-dynamics — the (c) prefix marking that this is the concept of political consciousness, not a particular policy. MT-INFO (multi-information) branches from the main line and carries POL-P (political policies). INFO-AF-B (information-affinity basis) also branches from the main line and carries LK-IMP (linkage implications), which carries ALT-F (alternative functionalism), and IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics), which carries MOT-DY.
